title: Valladolid debate
summary: Wikidata item Q1229264, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "moral debate in Spain between 1550–1551 to discuss the rights and treatment of a colonized people by colonizers". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
